title: Local Regularity Estimation through Sobolev-Scale Norm Profile
summary: We develop a kernel-based approach for estimating the spatially varying Sobolev regularity~$s$ of an unknown $d$-variate function~$f$ from scattered sampling data, which quantifies the degree of local differentiability supported by the data. Relying only on neighborhood data near the point of interest $z\in Ω_z$, our method constructs a sequence of Sobolev-space reproducing kernel interpolants whose kernel smoothness order is specified by an index~$m > d/2$. The native-space norms of these interpolants are evaluated over a bounded range of~$m$, producing a \emph{Sobolev-scale norm profile}.…
